Name: Halloween Hat Mouse
Author: BerryBea
Description:
The Hat Mouse is here to help you get ready for Spirit's Eve! They will be selling spooky and costume-based hats and masks from Friday - Sunday each week in autumn. Each weekend, there will be a different set of around 10 hats and masks. (If you've already unlocked a hat and it's something Hat Mouse sells, it will not show up again in the group of new hats, so you may have fewer than 10.) The exception to the changing inventory is the Witch Hat which is there every week and at a cheaper price, just as a little bonus.

Inventory Spoilers:
[spoiler]Week one: Witch Hat, Cowboy Hat, Chicken Mask, Gnome's Cap, Squire Helmet, Totem Mask, Frog Hat, Qi Mask, Tricorn Hat, Pumpkin Mask, Golden Mask

Week two: Witch Hat, Tiara, Pirate Hat, Skeleton Mask, Mouse Ears, Archer's Cap, Hair Bone, Bluebird Mask, Warrior Helmet, Squid Hat, Raccoon Hat

Week three: Witch Hat, Deluxe Cowboy Hat, Goblin Mask, Cat Ears, Knight Helmet, Blobfish Mask, Swashbuckler Hat, Tiger Hat, Jester Hat, Space Helmet, Laurel Wreath Crown

Week four: Witch Hat, Infinity Crown, Deluxe Pirate Hat, Panda Hat, Dinosaur Hat, Wearable Dwarf Helm, Mummy Mask, Radioactive Goggles, ??? (Concerned Ape Mask), Leprechaun Hat, Junimo Hat[/spoiler]

Please note that these won't be available if the Hat Mouse hasn't yet shown up in your game file. You must have unlocked at least one of the Hat Mouse's normal hats so that they're present in your game. (I feel like most game files have Hat Mouse unlocked by the fall, but I just wanted to make sure this was clear.)

[b]Compatibility
[/b]This mod only adds existing game items to a vanilla shop, so it should be compatible with most other mods. The only possible conflict could be with another mod that adds items to the Hat Mouse shop, but even that is just as likely to work without problems. Please do let me know if you find any conflicts and I'll be happy to add that information.
